newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lille August air cargo up 12 pct, Jan-Aug up 8pct.
newsitem.headline: Lille August air cargo up 12 pct, Jan-Aug up 8pct.

text.p: Lille-Lesquin airport, in northern France, handled 1,666 tonnes of cargo traffic last month, up 12 percent on August 1995, airport authority figures show.
In the first eight months of 1996, Lille Airport handled 15,575 tonnes of freight traffic, an increase of eight percent on the same period last year.
Air France Europe and French handling agent, France Handling; KLM Royal Dutch Airlines NV via its handling unit CSC and DHL Worldwide Express generate the most cargo traffic at Lille airport.
